ABOUT.TITLE: A day rental, brought to you
ABOUT.P1: Yalla Scoot keeps a serviced fleet. You choose a vehicle in the app, pay the day rate, and delivery brings it.

SERVICES.TITLE: A full day, at your door
SERVICES.LEAD: You pay for the day, delivery hands you the vehicle, and rental is available 24 hours.
SERVICES.S1D: One fare covers the day. You see it in the app before you pay, and the vehicle stays with you for that day.
SERVICES.S2D: The app holds a wide choice. Pick the vehicle you need for the day.
SERVICES.S3D: You do not hunt for a scooter on the street. After you pay, delivery hands you the vehicle and you go.
SERVICES.S4D: Book the day in the app at any hour. If the vehicle is not right, another one is sent at no extra charge.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.MORE_BODY: Ride help stays in the app.
FAQ.ALT: Two people riding Yalla Scoot scooters
FAQ.Q1: How do I rent a vehicle?
FAQ.A1: Download the app, choose a vehicle, and pay the day rate. Delivery brings it to you.
FAQ.A3: Delivery covers the area shown in the app. Hurghada is open now, and more cities can be added.
FAQ.A4: Yes. You choose the vehicle and pay in the Yalla Scoot app. Delivery brings it.
FAQ.Q5: What if the vehicle is not right?
FAQ.A5: Say so in the app. Another vehicle is sent at no extra charge.
FAQ.Q6: What if the battery runs out?
FAQ.A6: Remaining range is shown before you pay. If it cannot cover the day, the app offers another vehicle at no extra charge.

RIDE.T3: Get it delivered to your door!
RIDE.D3: Your ride, delivered straight to your door. Pick it up and go!.
